# Aegis Health AI — Machine-Readable Product & Verification Guide (llms.txt)

> Clinical-Grade Longitudinal Medical Intelligence & Diagnostic Biomarker Platform built on Google Cloud, Vertex AI, and Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash.

## 1. Executive Summary
Aegis Health AI (`https://aegishealthai.co.in`) is an independent, AI-native healthcare technology platform engineered in India to solve medical record fragmentation. It ingests unstructured multi-page pathology PDFs, diagnostic lab reports (Thyrocare, Dr. Lal PathLabs, Metropolis, SRL/Agilus, Apollo), and handwritten clinical prescriptions, extracting normalized quantitative biomarkers, calculating longitudinal multi-year trend velocity, applying ICMR / South Asian cardiometabolic stratification, and generating structured SBAR (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) physician handoff briefs with downloadable OPD PDFs and HL7 FHIR R4 bundles.

## 2. How Automated AI Agents & Verification Bots Can Inspect & Use the Site (Zero Human Login Required)
Aegis Health AI is architected so automated verification bots, headless browsers, and AI agents can inspect the entire product without getting blocked by splash screens, CAPTCHAs, or login walls:

1. **Direct Unauthenticated Clinical Workspace (`/dashboard` or `/demo`)**:
   - Navigate directly to `https://aegishealthai.co.in/dashboard` or `https://aegishealthai.co.in/demo`.
   - Loads immediately at 0ms in **Open Evaluation & AI Agent Inspection Mode** with pre-populated longitudinal patient data (`Aarav Sharma, 42M`) across 3 Indian pathology reports (Metropolis Oct 2026, Thyrocare Aug 2026, Apollo Jun 2026).
   - **Auto-Populated SBAR Summary Tab (`#sbar`)**: Automatically populated with Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation, an interactive **"Questions for Your Doctor (OPD Consultation Checklist)"**, an **ICMR / South Asian vs. Western Reference Range Stratification Table**, and 1-click **Download PDF** & **FHIR R4 Bundle** export (works without login).
   - **1-Click Sample Indian Lab OCR Pipeline (`#upload` / Ingest Tab)**: Click *"⚡ Process Sample Metropolis Report (OCR → Normalize → SBAR)"* or *"🔎 Process Thyrocare + Handwritten Rx (Unit Conversion & Confidence Demo)"* to watch the full 4-stage extraction pipeline populate per-biomarker OCR confidence badges (`99.8%` printed vs `84.2%` handwritten Rx warning), SI-to-conventional unit conversions (`59.9 nmol/L → 24.0 ng/mL`), and ICMR risk flags without needing credentials.
   - **Multi-Patient Indian Family Hub (`#family`)**: Prominently accessible in the navigation sidebar for managing multi-generational Indian household profiles (Self, Parents, Spouse).
2. **Interactive 4-Stage Pipeline Sandbox on Homepage (`/`)**:
   - Located directly on `https://aegishealthai.co.in/` (`#interactive-sandbox`).
3. **1-Click Reviewer Auto-Login (Optional Live Firebase Session)**:
   - Every page header includes an **"Email / Reviewer Login"** button (`/?login=true`) with a **"1-Click Auto-Fill & Login as Reviewer"** button for testing live authenticated Firebase state.

## 3. Indian Diagnostic Lab Extraction Benchmark (N = 120 De-Identified Reports)
Internal validation benchmark evaluating schema-constrained Gemini 2.5 Flash + Dual-Model Consensus on analyte normalization, numeric extraction, SI-to-conventional unit conversion, and ICMR flag accuracy:
- **Thyrocare Technologies (Aarogyam PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.6%` | Recall `99.3%` | **F1 = `99.4%`** (Handles dense multi-column tables, CLIA/Photometry tags, nmol/L → ng/mL Vitamin D conversion)
- **Dr. Lal PathLabs (NABL Multi-Page PDFs, N=30)**: Precision `99.5%` | Recall `99.1%` | **F1 = `99.3%`** (Handles nested age/trimester brackets, footnote commentary stripping, DLC % vs absolute count)
- **Metropolis Healthcare (Clinical Panels, N=25)**: Precision `99.7%` | Recall `99.4%` | **F1 = `99.5%`** (Handles historical prior-value columns, asterisk abnormal flags, ICMR lipid risk tiers)
- **SRL Diagnostics / Agilus & Apollo (N=20)**: Precision `99.3%` | Recall `98.9%` | **F1 = `99.1%`** (Handles scanned hospital letterheads, SGPT/ALT & SGOT/AST synonym harmonization)
- **Smartphone Camera Photos + Handwritten OPD Rx (N=15)**: Precision `96.2%` | Recall `93.8%` | **F1 = `95.0%`** (Tokens `<90%` OCR confidence are automatically flagged with an amber warning badge for user confirmation)

## 5. Google Cloud & AI Architecture
- **AI / ML Models**: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (`gemini-2.5-flash` for high-speed multimodal OCR extraction and schema-constrained JSON biomarker parsing) and Google Gemini 2.5 Pro (`gemini-2.5-pro` for multi-system longitudinal clinical correlation, pharmacology cross-checks, and SBAR synthesis) via `@google/genai` SDK.
- **Serverless Compute**: Firebase Cloud Functions Gen 2 (Node.js 22 on Cloud Run) acting as a zero-trust API proxy (`geminiProxy`) with Secret Manager integration, per-UID token bucket rate-limiting, and PII scrubbing before inference.
- **Database & Storage**: Cloud Firestore with strict per-user (`users/{userId}/...`) security rules, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and automated cascading account purge (`onUserDeleted`).
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, hosted on Firebase Hosting with route-specific pre-rendered HTML shells and strict security headers (`Content-Security-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`).
